policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="answerText" value="@{
            if (context.Response.StatusCode != 200) { return ""; }
            var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            var text = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            var output = body["output"] as JArray;
            if (output == null) { return ""; }
            foreach (var item in output) {
                if ((string)item["type"] != "message") { continue; }
                var content = item["content"] as JArray;
                if (content == null) { continue; }
                foreach (var part in content) {
                    if ((string)part["type"] == "output_text") { text.Append((string)part["text"]); }
                }
            }
            return text.ToString();
        }" />

                    POST
                    
                        Bearer {{ai-guard-token}}
                    
                    
                        application/json
                    
                    @(new JObject(
                        new JProperty("event_type", "output"),
                        new JProperty("model", "{target-deployment}"),
                        new JProperty("guard_input", new JObject(
                            new JProperty("messages", new JArray(new JObject(
                                new JProperty("role", "assistant"),
                                new JProperty("content", (string)context.Variables["answerText"]))))))).ToString())
